subject: [PATCH 02/10] mm/madvise: name the shared LRU PMD callback

reviews.author: Lorenzo Stoakes (ARM)
reviews.summary: Approved the renaming of the shared LRU PMD callback to madvise_lru_pmd_entry(), considering it handles THP PMDs and PTE ranges, making 'LRU' a reasonable name.

2026-09-22.patch_summary: This patch renames the shared LRU PMD callback in mm/madvise.c to madvise_lru_pmd_entry() to better reflect its purpose and functionality, which is to handle both THP PMDs and PTE ranges.
